newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet tumbles with NYMEX, Gulf diffs ease.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet tumbles with NYMEX, Gulf diffs ease.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices tumbled more than 2.50 cents a gallon on Monday amid a NYMEX selloff sparked by news of United Nations approval earlier in the day of an oil-for-food deal with Iraq.
Differentials held steady on New York Harbor aviation-quality 54-grade fuel, with offers at about 2.85 cents over January futures, players said.

But Gulf material saw diffs ease about 0.15 cent, with deals done at 1.15 cents under the January print. "Several majors came out selling so barrels weren't very hard to come by," one Gulf trader said.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
